green_summary.Registry.v1: infra/delivery/registry.json + registry.schema.json. project(id/owner/delegates/github repoId=1285806550 principalId=262266039/authority readback) + resources[] (id/kind/owner/backupOwner/purpose/audience/credentialRef/lockRef/runtimeRequirement/domain/retention). First real resource comet-source pinned to integrations/comet/upstream.lock.json. Hand-rolled validator (no new deps): known-owner set, cross-project ref refusal, image digest pinning/format, retention auto-cleanup gate, plaintext/host-path scan; refs+policy load is fail-closed (missing file = input error, never silent empty rules).
green_summary.SecretRef.v1: tools/infra/secret-refs.mjs. parseSecretRef (secret-ref:<project>/<name> kebab), validateRefsCatalog (purpose-bound, single binding per ref, roles constrained by qualification-policy.json, ROLE_REUSE on any duplicate binding), resolveSecretRef read-only gate: parse -> project match -> registered -> principal+role, then returns UNRESOLVED/NO_RUNTIME_SECRET_STORE_AUTHORIZATION and never a value; plaintext/secret-key/host-path scanners are compiled invariants. secrets.refs.example.json registers the 12 planned sdd-harness-pilot refs, all NOT_PROVISIONED, no values.
green_summary.Qualification.v1: tools/infra/registry.mjs validate|qualify|status|up|readback. Exit contract 0=PASS 1=input/prerequisite 2=verification failure. qualify evaluates 8 policy-declared evidence categories with an honest ladder: VERIFIED (recomputed this run) / RECORDED (in lock only) / UNVERIFIED (reason required) / MISMATCH. Receipt binds inputs to actual sha256 (registry, lock, archive, npm metadata). Deep run with the real comet archive: source-commit VERIFIED via tar listing, source-digest VERIFIED (28a7e2fa... = lock, 40474019 bytes), license VERIFIED (MIT bound via npm version+integrity). ready requires all VERIFIED; up refuses with UP_REFUSED_QUALIFICATION_NOT_READY while not ready and would refuse UP_NOT_AUTHORIZED even when ready (policy upGate.enabled=false in I01). Runtime observation includes node v22.13.1 vs required ^22.16.0||>=24.0.0 -> satisfied=false, and tool-redacted host paths in runtime error text.
